summary: Iteration 6 — Frontend-only smoke test of the new Slangcart admin web app (STORE / OPERATIONS / EXPORT DATA grouped sidebar + 22 new admin routes). RESULT: ~98% PASS. Admin login (support@networkrupay.com / Nlee@1115) lands on /dashboard. Sidebar shows the 3 group headings (STORE, OPERATIONS, EXPORT DATA) and ALL 31 expected admin-nav-* data-testids are present and clickable (verified admin-nav-shop-layout, admin-nav-system-wallet-treasury, admin-nav-legal-pages route to the correct URLs). All 22 new admin pages render with their primary data-testid: sl-add, sc-add, pb-add, aa-list, ar-table, rr-table, pg-status, va-list, sa-list, sc-cat-list+sc-sub-list, sva-by-cat, ad-list, sw-buckets, av-table, bk-list, tx-list, al-list, settings-form, lp-editor, ex-grid+ex-users (plus /admin/upi-payments renders an empty-state without crashing). Real-data assertions verified: /admin/payment-gateway shows 'Key ID: rzp_test_SjgtHA4CxiFyTK' (env source, TEST mode); /admin/system-wallet shows non-zero treasury buckets (Referral ₹161.25, Fee Residual ₹2,537.43, GST collected ₹306.18, etc.); /admin/analytics aa-stats shows real KPIs (New users month=17, Total revenue ₹2,006, System wallet ₹421.14, Success txns=17); /admin/settings settings-form shows payout_l1=400 plus payout_l2..payout_l10, registration_fee=118, directs_required=5, vendor_commission_pct=70 — full payout-structure editor present; /admin/legal-pages lp-editor loads the 'Edit /legal/terms · Save page' editor; /admin/backups bk-list renders with snapshot rows; /admin/transactions tx-list and /admin/audit-logs al-list both show large lists. /admin/exports ex-users click triggered a real CSV download ('users.csv'). Existing admin pages did not regress (/admin/users, /admin/withdrawals wd-table, /admin/tickets at-table, /admin/kyc kyca-table, /admin/approvals ap-tab-pending, /admin/products, /admin/orders, /admin/branding, /admin/broadcast all render). Regular-user login (Test@gmail.com / Just@4me) lands on /dashboard; sidebar does NOT contain 'STORE'/'OPERATIONS'/'EXPORT DATA' (role-gated correctly); cart icon visible. ONE BUG FOUND AND FIXED IN-PLACE: /admin/changes was crashing with React error 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {id, name})' because the backend now returns admin_id (or target_id / admin_role) as an object {id,name} instead of a string. Patched AdminChanges.jsx to coerce these fields safely via a local `safe()` helper. After the fix, ch-list renders with 100 entries (e.g. service_category.update, user.approve, admin.role_change, distributor.toggle, shop_categories.create, payment.upi_manual.approve, product.update, branding.update, product.create) with timestamps and admin emails — zero page errors.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED in this iteration — page was crashing because c.admin_id / c.admin_role / c.target_id can be objects ({id, name}) and were being rendered as React children directly. Added a safe() coercion helper to render the .name/.email/.id field. Same defensive pattern should be considered for other admin pages that render arbitrary admin/target fields (AdminAuditLogs, AdminApprovedRegistrations, AdminRejectedRegistrations) in case the backend evolves.

settings-form exposes editable inputs for non-business fields like `id` (value 'global'), `danger_pin_hash` (the bcrypt hash) and `danger_pin_set_at`. Hashes/internal identifiers should not be exposed/editable in a settings UI — they are not relevant to payout structure and an accidental edit could brick the danger-pin flow.

issues: The Operations group is very long (~28 items) — consider a sub-collapse or scroll hint so the EXPORT DATA group does not get lost below the fold on smaller laptop screens.

action_items: REVIEW the AdminChanges.jsx fix I applied (added safe() coercion). Consider applying the same defensive pattern in AdminAuditLogs/AdminApprovedRegistrations/AdminRejectedRegistrations to harden them against backend response-shape drift.

Filter AdminSettings.jsx render so internal/sensitive keys (id, danger_pin_hash, danger_pin_set_at, *_hash, *_at) are NOT shown as editable inputs in the settings-form — only show business knobs (registration_fee, payout_l1..l10, directs_required, vendor_commission_pct, auto_approve_on_payment, phone_reveal_fee, phone_reveal_gst_pct, shop_margin_enabled, service_booking_margin_enabled).
Optional: collapse the long Operations group into sub-sections (User mgmt / Catalog ops / Finance / Audit) to improve sidebar scannability.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminChanges.jsx was directly rendering API fields as React children without coercion. ANY backend that switches a string field (admin_id, target_id, action) to an object will hard-crash the page. The fix added a `safe()` helper. Recommend a shared util (e.g. src/lib/safe.js -> safeText(v)) reused across all admin list pages.

AdminSettings.jsx renders EVERY key from the settings document, including the bcrypt danger_pin_hash. This is both a UX leak and a footgun. The form should whitelist editable keys, not iterate over Object.keys(data).
Sidebar Layout.jsx correctly applies data-testid=`admin-nav-${kebab(label)}` to every NavLink — all 31 expected testids resolved on first paint. Good.

Defensive `data?.items || (Array.isArray(data) ? data : [])` pattern is used consistently across the new admin pages — good resilience against the {items:[]} vs raw-array shape variance noted by the main agent.
REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is correctly pointing to https://network-pay-1.emergent.host (verified iteration_5 regression has not recurred).
/admin/exports CSV download path works — server response was streamed as users.csv. No 500.
/admin/payment-gateway correctly displays the source='env' Razorpay key id (rzp_test_SjgtHA4CxiFyTK) and masked secret — sensitive-data hygiene is good.
Regular user role gating works — STORE/OPERATIONS/EXPORT DATA group labels do NOT render in the sidebar for Test@gmail.com.

If the backend response shape evolves further (e.g. admin_role becomes object), the same helper will absorb it. rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (/admin/changes crash): GET /api/admin/changes now returns each entry with admin_id (and possibly admin_role or target_id) as an object {id, name} instead of a plain string. AdminChanges.jsx was rendering `{c.admin_email || c.admin_id || '—'}` directly inside JSX — React throws 'Objects are not valid as a React child' when admin_email is missing and admin_id is an object. REPRODUCTION: visit /admin/changes as admin (support@networkrupay.com) on the network-pay-1 backend; pre-fix you'd get the red runtime overlay 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {id, name})'. MITIGATION: Added a `safe(v)` helper inside the map callback that returns v.name || v.email || v.id || JSON.stringify(v) for objects and String(v) for primitives. Applied to action, admin_email, admin_id, admin_role, target_type, target_id. Page now renders 100 entries with zero React errors.
